work.summary: Investigated the repeated field report that highway sections were not red and that fullscreen PINs were not usable. Found that the product intentionally used orange, not red, and that fullscreen map z-order/native element fullscreen could hide machine-detail UI. FINAL.27 uses red for motorway or tollway route spans, keeps ordinary roads blue, removes dependence on map-element native fullscreen, raises modals above the fullscreen map, and makes machine PIN wrappers explicitly interactive.
